reviews.title: Premium feel & Perfect satisfying click
reviews.comment: Heavier than I thought it would be and it feels premium for the low price tag. There are tons of color options for the RBG and you can even write your own to fully customize. The perfect satisfying click sound - like an old 90’s IBM computer. It came with a charging cord and keycap remover tool. Very worth the price!!! I personally didn’t like the keys but always planned to swap them out. They were easy to remove so 5++++ stars for sure
reviews.author: Andie

reviews.title: Beautiful Keyboard!
reviews.comment: This keyboard is so nice! It has a fantastic weight to it, it's not heavy per se but it feels expensive. This might sound stupid, but I bought this specifically for Fortnite Festival. My other keyboards have keys that get stuck easy and I have a difficult time cleaning underneath the keys. This keyboard fixed all of those issues. There are no sidewalls for dust and hair to get stuck in, which can be a pro and a con. You can easily see the switches, but I think that's a pro because I can easily lube the switches if I want to in the future. The sound is super clacky, so beware of that, but you can always watch youtube videos on how to lube your own keys and get cheap key lube from microcenter or best buy! I think this keyboard is worth it!! Especially with the wireless option!
reviews.author: Rebecca

reviews.title: For those who want the typewriter qualities and modern day exepince this is the keyboard to buy!
reviews.comment: This keyboard is wonderful; the colors, functionality, and aesthetics are beautiful. The keyboard sounds are 100% amazing. The animation in the color changes is phenomenal. Please do buy this item. The only reason I returned it was because I mistook it for one that had Bluetooth when it didn't. The weight and the stand are durable and lightweight. Easily moved, and the cords came and worked. The packaging was absolutely wonderful. Overall, the experience was luxurious. I am actually using this keyboard to write my review before I return it. Please do try this product!
reviews.author: Aurelila Rabitito

reviews.title: Awesome sound!
reviews.comment: I love this keyboard. One of my computers serves two rooms, with monitors on both sides of a wall. This keyboard works perfectly in both rooms. So the wireless connection is strong. The sound when typing is very satisfying, and the lighting is nice. I have used Redragon mechanical keyboards on all my computers for years and they are very quality keyboards, this is my first time using the wireless ones, I have one black and one white, and both seem to be the quality I have come to expect. And the price point is good.
reviews.author: Deanna Powers

reviews.title: Awesome Keyboard!!!
reviews.comment: I love this keyboard!!!! I use it for work and gratefully the sounds of the keys aren’t annoying my coworkers. I’ve got coworkers who actually want to order one for themselves!!! It’s functional, stable keyboard, durable, compatible with my PC and no issues. It’s a heavy solid keyboard. I love the lights on it too. This keyboard looks great and the size isn’t too big or too small. It’s perfect for what I need it for!!
